Baseline Padel has a policy called "Child Supervision and Drop-Off" that applies to all branches. It states that responsibility for a child's welfare must always be clearly defined between the parent or guardian and Baseline Padel staff, with no ambiguous handover periods during which nobody is accountable for a minor's whereabouts. This means you cannot leave your 6-year-old child alone at the club without supervision while you play. The club ensures that a child is always under the care of either a parent, guardian, or authorized staff.

If you cancel a court reservation two hours before the scheduled start time, it falls within the late cancellation window. According to Baseline Padel's Booking & Cancellation Policy, members may cancel free of charge only up to six hours before the start time. Cancellations made later than six hours before the session begins, including two hours before, are subject to late cancellation terms which may involve charges or penalties. 

For full details on the late cancellation terms, you may want to check with the club directly or through the app.
